column4: Hunt a Whitetail Buck and a Whitetail Doe in forest near streams around Mount Kalaga or the Abandoned Concrete Plant. Use a scoped Shrewsbury SM-69 and a clean head/heart shot; Focus (L3+R3) highlights vitals. Deliver both in Pristine or Good condition. Small carcasses can fit in vehicle trunks. For large animals, as Jason use the photo/location collection prompt and leave the area for payment; wait if Bret is processing another pickup. Read his texts for time-of-day clues. Return carcasses to Bret's Drop Off shed near Killtelligence Provisions; a roomy vehicle may fit both. Reported value: buck $290-$505, doe $220-$380. Use the ringed lake search area west of Millport; look for the purple deer-head icon with a J. Track the scent trail with Triangle/Y. If both carcasses do not fit, make two trips; the order stays active. Kalaga River is another reported deer habitat; approach from downwind. Use Bret’s tutorial Killtelligence SM-69 until the store restriction clears. The November 25 hunting guide reports holding R1/RB to study an animal through binoculars or a scope; use D-pad Up/Down for zoom.\nOutput Lag: Bret reportedly provides a W-22 when the first numbered deck is finished; check inventory before buying. Return both carcasses together in Jason’s 72 Tulip or a pickup; turning in one at the drop-off reportedly credits the others stored in the same vehicle. Reported deck payout: $885.

column3: Adler Creek, Bonanza and Mount Kalaga
column4: Hunt a white-feathered Leonida Wild White Tom (turkey; ordinary turkey does not count), Eastern Spotted Skunk and Wild Boar in Adler Creek, Bonanza or Mount Kalaga. Look for the skunk after about 8 PM and boar in shaded woodland. A Wortham W-22 is reported for turkey/skunk, Shrewsbury SM-69 for boar; preserve Pristine or Good carcasses. Small carcasses can fit in vehicle trunks. For large animals, as Jason use the photo/location collection prompt and leave the area for payment; wait if Bret is processing another pickup. Read his texts for time-of-day clues. Try the river northeast of Bret's BV blip below the highway: boar and white turkey near water, skunk trails on the hill above the road. Active-deck spawns may be more frequent; move slowly through long grass. Boar and skunks are primarily nocturnal; boar may also appear in sheltered woodland in daylight. Individual hunting-area maps are selectable; these mark general habitats rather than a guaranteed animal spawn. Adler Creek: a steel truss bridge marks the grassy creekside area north of the divided highway. Search brush by the bridge approach after dark; confirm the Eastern Spotted Skunk in Focus.\nBret’s reported message explicitly requests a photo and location for the boar.\nWhite Tom and Eastern Spotted Skunk: W-22. Wild Boar: SM-69, then D-pad Up photo request. If repeatedly failing to find targets, save and reload. Reported deck payout: $2,350.

column3: West and East Buckskin Swamp; Pelican Valley
column4: Hunt a cane toad, nutria and Nile monitor. The Wortham W-22 is recommended for all three to avoid ruining small carcasses. Wait for Bret's text after completing the previous deck. Small carcasses can fit in vehicle trunks. For large animals, as Jason use the photo/location collection prompt and leave the area for payment; wait if Bret is processing another pickup. Read his texts for time-of-day clues. Search wetland edges for nutria and Nile monitors; cane toads also inhabit coastal areas. The November 24 hunting guide reports transporting all three small carcasses yourself. Pelican Valley is a general hunting area. Individual hunting-area maps are selectable; these mark general habitats rather than a guaranteed animal spawn. Check the active target label: Focus may display the cane toad as Frog.\nW-22 for all three targets. Watch the water for the swimming Nile Monitor; search land for the Cane Toad and Nutria. Reported deck payout: $920.

column4: Deck 04, Jason only. Golden Fox, Eastern Diamondback Rattlesnake and Nine-Banded Armadillo: W-22 for all three. Look for a lone fox pouncing in the field. Reported payout: $3,100.
